justifications.text: Uses the Steam connection of PlayerVox OverCrow to read your game and your achievements, read only. Your Steam key is sensitive: it can also manage your item trades. This widget never calls a trade route (no IEconService), never sees the key, and PlayerVox OverCrow sends the key only to api.steampowered.com. To revoke it: steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey, then "Revoke My Steam Web API Key". Never show that page on stream.
Finds the SteamID of the profile link you enter when it uses a custom name (steamcommunity.com/id/<name>). Only when you enter or change your profile.
Reads which game your profile is playing now and whether its details are public. Once a minute while the widget is shown.
Finds your last game played and its icon when you are not in a game. When the game changes, then every 10 minutes out of game.
Reads which achievements of the shown game you unlocked, and when. Once a minute in game, every 10 minutes out of game.
Reads the names, descriptions and icons of the shown game's achievements, in your language. Once per game and language, then kept in storage.
Reads the share of players who unlocked each achievement (rarity). Once per game and day, without your key.

Shows the icons of the achievements on screen and of the game, the file name taken from Steam's answer and checked (<name>.jpg). The one path Steam serves for every game, recent ones included. Each icon once; a failure is not asked again for an hour.
Shows the store image of the shown game. Once per game; a failure is not asked again for an hour.
The same store image on Steam's other image host, when the first one has none.
Keeps your profile link, the achievements you track (up to three per game, for your last 20 games), the last values shown and the achievement lists of your last three games, on this computer.
